announcements_window_check.name: announcements_window_check
announcements_window_check.value: "announcements"."starts_at" is null or "announcements"."ends_at" is null or "announcements"."ends_at" >= "announcements"."starts_at"

shortlinks_slug_check.name: shortlinks_slug_check
shortlinks_slug_check.value: length("shortlinks"."slug") between 1 and 64 and "shortlinks"."slug" not glob '*[^a-z0-9-]*' and "shortlinks"."slug" not glob '-*' and "shortlinks"."slug" not glob '*-' and "shortlinks"."slug" not glob '*--*'

shortlinks_target_check.name: shortlinks_target_check
shortlinks_target_check.value: ("shortlinks"."target_url" like '/%' and "shortlinks"."target_url" not like '//%') or "shortlinks"."target_url" like 'http://%' or "shortlinks"."target_url" like 'https://%'

site_resources_shape_check.name: site_resources_shape_check
site_resources_shape_check.value:
("site_resources"."content_type" = 'file' and "site_resources"."file_path" is not null and "site_resources"."file_size" is not null and "site_resources"."external_url" is null and "site_resources"."body_text" is null)
        or ("site_resources"."content_type" = 'url' and "site_resources"."external_url" is not null and "site_resources"."file_path" is null and "site_resources"."file_size" is null and "site_resources"."body_text" is null)
        or ("site_resources"."content_type" = 'text' and "site_resources"."body_text" is not null and "site_resources"."file_path" is null and "site_resources"."file_size" is null and "site_resources"."external_url" is null)

blog_posts_slug_check.name: blog_posts_slug_check
blog_posts_slug_check.value: length("blog_posts"."slug") between 1 and 160 and "blog_posts"."slug" not glob '*[^a-z0-9-]*' and "blog_posts"."slug" not glob '-*' and "blog_posts"."slug" not glob '*-' and "blog_posts"."slug" not glob '*--*'

blog_posts_image_size_check.name: blog_posts_image_size_check
blog_posts_image_size_check.value: (("blog_posts"."image_width" is null) = ("blog_posts"."image_height" is null)) and ("blog_posts"."image_width" is null or ("blog_posts"."image_width" > 0 and "blog_posts"."image_height" > 0))

media_dimensions_check.name: media_dimensions_check
media_dimensions_check.value: (("media"."width" is null) = ("media"."height" is null)) and ("media"."width" is null or ("media"."width" > 0 and "media"."height" > 0))
